sources.title: The Minto Pyramid Principle: public concept and course explanations
sources.author: Barbara Minto
sources.accessScope: Complete public concept and course pages plus home/textbook description. Site names the SCQ Framework; no paid book or course was read.
sources.rights: Copyright and trademarks retained by Minto. No source prose or checklist bundled.

rules.intent: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.
rules.rationale: Shared project meaning-preservation requirement; style never authorizes factual change.

rules.intent: State only the shared context needed to understand the decision.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: Explain unfamiliar context when readers do not share it.

rules.intent: Identify an evidenced change, obstacle, or tension that makes a decision necessary.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: If no complication is supported, say so rather than inventing one.

rules.intent: Formulate the reader question raised by that complication.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: Retain a question explicitly chosen by the user.

rules.intent: Answer that question with a supported recommendation and retain its conditions.
rules.rationale: The explicit four-part SCQA opening is a project adaptation of the publicly described SCQ framework, not a verified full-book recipe.
